description: A React component defining the homepage for a dashboard that connects to JIRA and Confluence, manages their statuses, fetches and displays projects, and handles OAuth flow and tokens.

methods.name: fetchStatuses
methods.description: Fetches the connection status for JIRA and Confluence from API endpoints and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: loadProjects
methods.description: Loads the list of JIRA projects from the API, updates project list and statuses, handles errors.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Updates search query and triggers project reload based on the query.

methods.name: startOAuth
methods.description: Initiates OAuth flow by fetching the authorization URL and redirecting the browser.

methods.name: handleJiraCTA
methods.description: Handles the click action for the JIRA connector, either refreshes projects if connected or starts OAuth.

methods.name: handleConfluenceCTA
methods.description: Handles the click action for Confluence connector, either opens spaces or initiates OAuth flow.

methods.name: renderProjects
methods.description: Renders the list of projects, loading states, or error messages.
